title: Harness audio-consumer activation is keyed on hardcoded demo names, not a demo directive — a future audio golden silently runs vacuous
detail: Every other run-setup/behavior piece in this harness rides the demo file (fixture, era, growth, pauses, spawns, captures). Name-keying means a third audio golden added without editing run.odin runs with no consumer AND no vacuous-guards (the guards at 463-477 share the same gate) — silently reintroducing the r1 W3/W4 vacuous-golden failure mode.
recommended_fix: Add a demo directive (e.g. `audio on`) parsed into Demo/Demo_Replay like `fixture off`, and key the consumer + per-kind guards on it, so new audio goldens are self-describing and cannot bypass the guards.
